release_notes: Orbitra 2.0.1: installation now works on minimal Ubuntu/Debian images that ship without the cron package — install.sh installs and enables cron itself and verifies the background jobs were actually scheduled (the field report was an install whose click spool, WAL checkpoints, postback queue, SSL, geo and aggregator had never run once). System status now tells 'background tasks not configured' from 'went stale', shows the cron diagnosis and the fix command, and the server-setup banner returns whenever background tasks are provably broken — an in-panel update can never install a package. Also: adding a domain can create its Cloudflare zone and set the assigned name servers at Namecheap/Dynadot; Trends Regexp / Regexp-exclude filters actually filter now.
